Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a chemical cross-linking (CXMS) study using the MS-cleavable linker DSSO. While the PRIDE metadata mentions 'No PTMs', the methods explicitly describe the use of DSSO as a dynamic modification for lysines to map protein-protein interactions. The use of an MS2-MS3 workflow is characteristic of DSSO analysis to identify cross-linked peptides.

Ontology_ProcessingAndDifferential_promp.notes: The experiment is a targeted CXMS (Chemical Cross-Linking Mass Spectrometry) study using the MS-cleavable linker DSSO. It requires a specialized pipeline (like XlinkX) capable of handling MS2-MS3 transitions to identify crosslinked peptides. The use of α-lytic protease instead of trypsin is a critical search parameter.
